title: Niagara Region Charter Service
specs: Fish the world famous Niagara Region of Lakes Erie, Ontario, and the Niagara River

blurb: Guests fish the Niagara Region's lakes and river for trophy Smallmouth Bass, Muskellunge, Walleye, King Salmon, Coho Salmon, Brown Trout, Lake Trout, and Steelhead. The service offers guided fishing trips with Captain Frank Campbell on Lake Erie, Lake Ontario, and the Niagara River. The fishery is world class and offers opportunities year-round.
